sentence: You almost always get three or more.

sentence: The physicist Richard Feynman noticed this, and asked why.

source_title: Heisser, Patil, Stoop, Villermaux, Dunkel, 'Controlling fracture cascades through twisting and quenching', PNAS 115, 8665 (2018); arXiv:1802.05402 (full text read, 9 Nov 2026)
